rules.title: Chat rules
rules.site:
• No threats, harassment, hate or discrimination. Insulting anyone's family is not allowed, not even as a joke.
  • Don't post other people's personal data (addresses, phone numbers, photos without consent).
  • No spam, ads, scams or mentioning services for hacking or fraud.
  • Occasional swearing is fine unless the streamer forbids it. Rough banter only if the streamer allows it.

For violations the streamer can ban you from their chat, and the administration can issue a warning or block the account without warning. Details are in the terms of use.
rules.note: Follow the channel and you won't have to confirm the rules again. Without following — once a day.
